description: This file defines an interface 'ValidatorInterface' in the SuiteCRM API JSON API filter namespace. It specifies a contract for validation classes with a method 'isValid' to determine if a given block of data is valid.
external_files: other SuiteCRM and SugarCRM core files that may implement or interact with this interface

classes.name: ValidatorInterface
classes.description: An interface that mandates the implementation of the 'isValid' method used for validating blocks of data.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Method that determines whether a given data block is valid. Takes a mixed-type parameter and returns a boolean.
